title: SWE-Sharp-Bench: A Reproducible Benchmark for C# Software Engineering Tasks
authors_zh: Sanket Mhatre, Yasharth Bajpai, Sumit Gulwani, Emerson Murphy-Hill, Gustavo Soares
paper_type_zh: 可程序验证的仓库级性能优化基准
best_for_zh: 需要以正确性测试和可复现运行时共同评测代码智能体的研究者。
one_line: SWE-Sharp-Bench brings reproducible, test-verified software-engineering tasks to 150 C#/.NET instances across 17 repositories.
SWE-Sharp-Bench 提供 150 个 C#/.NET 真实仓库任务，并以 .NET 测试执行验证智能体修复。
why: It evaluates a patch through executable behavior and measured runtime rather than a text-only judgment.
inclusion_reason: Each record couples a repository modification with executable tests and a measured terminal performance outcome.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Mainstream repository-level agent benchmarks focus on Python, and some multilingual work adds Java, JavaScript, or C and C++, but enterprise C# and .NET remain underrepresented. NuGet dependencies, MSBuild, solution and project structures, and xUnit or NUnit tests differ greatly from Python, so strong SWE-bench Verified results do not establish .NET competence.

SWE-Sharp-Bench constructs 150 real C# issue-resolution tasks from 17 open-source repositories. Each provides a base commit, problem statement, gold patch, test information, and reproducible .NET environment, and repository tests judge agent patches. The authors release both data and the full curation pipeline and compare C# with Python under identical model and agent configurations.

主流 repository-level agent benchmark 主要覆盖 Python，部分多语言工作加入 Java、JavaScript、C/C++，但企业常用的 C#/.NET 仍缺少可重复评测。NuGet 依赖、MSBuild、solution/project 结构和 xUnit/NUnit 测试与 Python 环境差异很大，因此在 SWE-bench Verified 的高分不能说明 agent 能处理 .NET 项目。

SWE-Sharp-Bench 从真实 C# 开源仓库构建 150 个 issue-resolution 实例，覆盖 17 个项目。每题提供 base commit、问题描述、gold patch、测试信息和可复现 .NET 环境；agent patch 由原仓库测试执行判定。作者同时公开数据与完整 curation pipeline，并在相同 agent/model 配置下与 Python benchmark 对照。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html: The main contribution is the first reproducible SWE-bench-style benchmark dedicated to C# and .NET. Its 150 records are released through CSV and Hugging Face, with fields centered on repositories, base commits, issues or problem statements, patches, tests, and environments; the code repository contains mining, solution-building, and evaluation scripts. Tasks come from 17 active C# projects and are replayed with dotnet, MSBuild, and native project test frameworks. A patch is resolved only when target and regression tests pass. The CDLA-Permissive-2.0 release supports cross-language coding-agent evaluation, .NET environment adaptation, and C# repository retrieval and is primarily a test benchmark rather than training data.

核心贡献是首个专门面向 C#/.NET 的可复现 SWE-bench 风格 benchmark。150 条数据以 CSV/Hugging Face 形式公开，字段围绕 repository、base commit、issue/problem statement、patch、测试与环境配置组织；代码仓库提供候选挖掘、solution 构建和评测脚本。实例来自 17 个活跃 C# 项目，使用 dotnet/MSBuild 和项目原生测试框架重放，补丁只有通过目标与回归测试才算 resolved。数据许可为 CDLA-Permissive-2.0，可用于 coding agent 跨语言评测、.NET 环境适配和 C# repository retrieval 研究，主要定位是 test benchmark 而非训练集。

title: Method
方法
html:
1. Select C# repositories: Filter active, publicly usable .NET projects with issues, pull requests, and automated tests, and collect pre-fix commits, merged patches, and problem descriptions.
  1. Build .NET environments: Restore NuGet dependencies, identify .sln or .csproj files, SDKs, and test frameworks, and verify that base and gold versions compile in fixed containers.
  1. Extract verification tests: Compare pre- and post-fix results, retain failing tests repaired by the gold patch, and record regression tests that must remain passing. Remove flaky candidates and tasks requiring external services or unstable builds.
  1. Review and release: Check issue–patch alignment, solvability, and environment instructions, yielding 150 tasks and a public curation and evaluation pipeline. Reproduction requires fixed .NET SDKs, NuGet caches, operating systems, commits, and test filters.

1. 选择 C# 仓库： 筛选活跃、可公开使用、具有 issue/PR 和自动化测试的 .NET 项目，获取修复前 commit、合并 patch 与问题描述。
  1. 构建 .NET 环境： 恢复 NuGet 依赖，识别 .sln/.csproj、SDK 与测试框架，在固定容器中确认 base 和 gold 版本可编译。
  1. 提取验证测试： 比较修复前后测试结果，保留能由 gold patch 修复的失败测试，并记录必须持续通过的回归测试；剔除 flaky、依赖外部服务或无法稳定构建的候选。
  1. 人工复核与发布： 检查 issue–patch 对齐、任务可解性和环境说明，最终保留 150 题并公开 curation/evaluation pipeline。复现需固定 .NET SDK、NuGet cache、操作系统、commit 和测试过滤规则。

title: Evidence
证据
html: The authors compare Python SWE-bench Verified and C# SWE-Sharp-Bench using identical model–agent configurations. The resolved rate is about 70% on Python but only about 40% on C#, a thirty-point gap. Holding models, scaffolds, and evaluation procedures constant strongly indicates that language ecosystems and toolchain transfer remain bottlenecks. Automated replay of 150 tasks from 17 repositories also supports reproducibility. However, the two benchmarks are not strictly matched for task difficulty, repository count, or issue distribution, so the gap cannot be attributed entirely to C# syntax, and with only 150 tasks individual repositories can strongly affect aggregate scores.

作者使用完全相同的 model–agent 配置对 SWE-bench Verified 的 Python 任务和 SWE-Sharp-Bench 的 C# 任务进行对照：Python resolved rate 约 70%，C# 仅约 40%，差 30 个百分点。由于模型、scaffold 和评测流程保持一致，该实验有力说明语言生态与工具链迁移仍是瓶颈；150 题可在 17 个仓库中自动重放，也支持可复现性。边界是两套 benchmark 的任务难度、仓库数量和 issue 分布并未严格匹配，差距不能全部归因于 C# 语法；此外 150 题样本较小，单个仓库会明显影响总体分数。

title: Novelty
新意
html: Multi-SWE-bench covers several non-Python languages but does not systematically address C# solutions and projects, NuGet, or MSBuild. Replacing a test command with dotnet test is insufficient for replaying historical commits. SWE-Sharp-Bench builds an end-to-end .NET curation pipeline and quantifies ecosystem transfer with an identical Python comparison. It does not change the SWE-bench contract of issue, patch, and tests; it adds an important enterprise language and releases the full path from mining and building to test selection and evaluation.

Multi-SWE-bench 已覆盖多种非 Python 语言，却没有系统处理 C# 的 solution/project、NuGet 和 MSBuild 生态；将普通测试脚本替换为 dotnet test 也不足以保证历史 commit 可重放。SWE-Sharp-Bench 的变化是为 .NET 建立端到端 curation pipeline，并用同配置 Python 对照量化生态迁移差距。它不改变 SWE-bench 的 issue + patch + tests 契约，而是补足一个重要企业语言并公开从挖掘、构建、测试选择到评测的完整再现路径。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
1. Imperfect comparison: The 70% Python and 40% C# results use the same agent but tasks are not matched one by one for patch length, file count, or difficulty. They establish a benchmark-level gap, not that language alone causes all differences.
  1. Limited tasks and repositories: The 150 tasks from 17 open projects do not cover large proprietary enterprise systems, Windows-specific UI, Azure services, or legacy .NET Framework. Per-repository results and uncertainty should accompany aggregates.
  1. Fragile environments: Historical NuGet packages, SDKs, platform behavior, and test frameworks change, and some tasks may be stable only on one OS. Reuse requires image digests, offline package caches, logs, and contamination checks for public issues and patches.

1. 对照不完全匹配： 70% Python 与 40% C# 使用同 agent，但任务本身未按补丁长度、文件数和难度逐题匹配，因此只能说明 benchmark-level gap，不能证明语言造成全部差异。
  1. 样本和仓库有限： 150 题来自 17 个开源项目，无法覆盖大型闭源企业系统、Windows 特定 UI、Azure 服务和旧版 .NET Framework；按仓库结果和置信区间应与总分同时报告。
  1. 环境脆弱： 历史 NuGet 包、SDK、平台行为和测试框架会变化，部分任务可能只在特定 OS 上稳定。复用需保存容器 digest、离线包缓存和测试日志，并检查公开 issue/patch 的预训练污染。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
1. Evaluate C# coding agents: Run agents in fixed .NET SDKs and containers and report resolved rate, build failures, test failures, and repository- or project-structure-stratified results, with Python or Java comparisons under the same scaffold.
  1. Study environment adaptation: Analyze agent errors involving .sln, .csproj, NuGet, MSBuild, and xUnit or NUnit and improve repository maps, command suggestions, and dependency restoration. Native tests remain the final oracle.
  1. Extend training data: Reuse the public curation pipeline to mine more C# pull requests, while deduplicating new tasks from the 150-task benchmark by commit. For proprietary enterprise .NET work, open-source data is only a foundation and not a representative distribution.

1. C# coding agent 评测： 在固定 .NET SDK/容器中运行 agent，报告 resolved rate、构建失败、测试失败和按仓库/项目结构分层结果，并与同 scaffold 的 Python 或 Java 对照。
  1. 环境适配研究： 分析 agent 在 .sln、.csproj、NuGet、MSBuild 和 xUnit/NUnit 上的工具错误，改进 repository map、命令建议和依赖恢复；最终仍以原生测试验收。
  1. 训练数据扩展模板： 复用公开 curation pipeline 挖掘更多 C# PR，但应把新任务与 150 题 benchmark 按 commit 去重。若研究需商业闭源 .NET 工作，开源数据只能作为基础，不能代表企业分布。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
1. One-sentence position: SWE-Sharp-Bench releases 150 executable C# and .NET repair tasks from 17 repositories plus the full construction pipeline.
  1. Method takeaway: Issue and pull-request mining, NuGet and SDK restoration, before–after test comparison, human alignment checks, and pinned containers determine reproducibility.
  1. Data takeaway: CSV and Hugging Face records include repositories, commits, problems, patches, tests, and environments under CDLA-Permissive-2.0.
  1. Evidence anchor: The same model–agent resolves about 70% of Python Verified but only about 40% of C# tasks, showing a large ecosystem-transfer gap.
  1. Reuse decision: It suits .NET agent evaluation and tooling adaptation. Task mismatch and dependency drift require per-repository reporting and pinned SDKs and images.

1. 一句话定位： SWE-Sharp-Bench 发布 150 个来自 17 个仓库的 C#/.NET 可执行修复任务和完整构建流程。
  1. 方法抓手： issue/PR 挖掘、NuGet 与 SDK 恢复、前后测试比较、人工对齐检查和容器固定决定可复现性。
  1. 数据抓手： CSV/HF 记录含 repository、commit、问题、patch、测试与环境；许可为 CDLA-Permissive-2.0。
  1. 证据锚点： 同 model–agent 在 Python Verified 约 70%，在 C# 仅约 40%，显示显著生态迁移差距。
  1. 复用决定： 适合 .NET agent 评测与工具适配；最大风险是任务不匹配和依赖漂移，必须按仓库报告并固定 SDK/镜像。
